results.query: Who are the top researchers in hydrogen catalysis?
results.sql_query: SELECT researcher, institution, state, research_area, h_index, funding_cr FROM c4_researcher_read_model WHERE topic IN ('Hydrogen Energy','Catalysis') ORDER BY h_index DESC LIMIT 5
results.response_excerpt: Hydrogen catalysis researcher evidence is resolved through hydrogen and catalysis terms in the researcher read model. Ravi Jena at Gujarat Technological University leads the visible slice with h-index 85. [cite:researchers:c4-read-model] [cite:institutions:c4-read-model]

results.query: Compare Gujarat and Maharashtra research output
results.sql_query: SELECT state, researcher_count FROM c4_researcher_state_read_model WHERE state IN (:state_a, :state_b) ORDER BY state
results.response_excerpt: Gujarat and Maharashtra are compared as state-bounded research-output slices. Gujarat has 886 researcher-output records in the visible read model; Maharashtra has 625. [cite:researchers:c4-read-model] [cite:institutions:c4-read-model]
